## Objective
The objective of this script is to split the sample for the project into batches for easier processing

## Samples 
All scanned fe_si_biopsies are eligble for inclusion (labl and pmi, regardless of scanner, even cases used for ai development)
Avoid duplicates imaged. 
Only include H&E

## Batches - status (update consecutively)
The status will be tracked here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EfFLsC8cyiQJYOmJotHQGPW0cQf2cDjd2f5WHxZJhb8/edit?usp=sharing

```{r}

output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/batches_for_process/"
#Use image_index with duplicate slides removed
image_index_deduplicated <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/index/image_index_deduplicated_2025-05-16.json")

#Only used H&E stained images
image_index_he <- image_index_deduplicated %>%
  filter(staining == "he") 

#Separate batches into already uploaded to aiforia and not

image_metadata <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_platforms/aiforia/output/general_subscription_info/image_metadata.json")

images_fragments_reviewed <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/process_reviewed_fragments/images_fragments_reviewed.json")


uploaded_to_aiforia <- image_index_he %>% filter(image_name %in% image_metadata$image_name)

not_uploaded_to_aiforia <- image_index_he %>% filter(!(image_name %in% image_metadata$image_name)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(vmacs_bx_year))

#Batch 0 is the grading sample - prioritized for processing
uploaded_to_aiforia_fragments_reviewed <- uploaded_to_aiforia %>% filter(image_name %in% images_fragments_reviewed)

batch_0 <- uploaded_to_aiforia_fragments_reviewed 

#Batch 1-3 are not uploaded to aiforia yet

slides_per_batch <- 225

batched <- not_uploaded_to_aiforia %>% 
  mutate(batch_idx   = ceiling(row_number() / slides_per_batch),
         batch_name = paste0("batch_", batch_idx))

batches <- batched %>% 
  group_split(batch_idx, .keep = TRUE) %>%               
  setNames(paste0("batch_", seq_len(length(.))))

batch_1 <- batches$batch_1
batch_2 <- batches$batch_2
batch_3 <- batches$batch_3


### Batch 4-6 are uploaded to aiforia, but the fragments havent been screeened (will be mixed if they are processed or not)


uploaded_to_aiforia_fragments_not_reviewed <- uploaded_to_aiforia %>% filter(!(image_name %in% images_fragments_reviewed))

slides_per_batch <- 236

offset <- 3

uploaded_to_aiforia_fragments_not_reviewed <- 
  uploaded_to_aiforia_fragments_not_reviewed %>% 
   arrange(
    desc(vmacs_bx_year),             # newest year → oldest
    desc(labl_date)                  # then newest labl_date → oldest
  )

next_batched <- uploaded_to_aiforia_fragments_not_reviewed %>% 
  mutate(batch_idx  = ceiling(row_number() / slides_per_batch) + offset,
         batch_name = paste0("batch_", batch_idx))

new_batches <- next_batched %>% 
  group_split(batch_idx, .keep = TRUE) %>% 
  setNames(unique(next_batched$batch_name))

batch_4 <- new_batches$batch_4
batch_5 <- new_batches$batch_5
batch_6 <- new_batches$batch_6

write_json(batch_0, paste0(output_dir, "batch_0.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(batch_1, paste0(output_dir, "batch_1.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(batch_2, paste0(output_dir, "batch_2.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(batch_3, paste0(output_dir, "batch_3.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(batch_4, paste0(output_dir, "batch_4.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(batch_5, paste0(output_dir, "batch_5.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(batch_6, paste0(output_dir, "batch_6.json"), pretty = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)

output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/batches_for_process/"

image_metadata <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_platforms/aiforia/output/general_subscription_info/image_metadata.json")

batch_0 <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "batch_0.json")) %>%
  mutate(processing_batch = "batch_0") %>%
  select(image_name, image_format, processing_batch)
batch_1 <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "batch_1.json")) %>%
  mutate(processing_batch = "batch_1") %>%
  select(image_name, image_format, processing_batch)
batch_2 <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "batch_2.json")) %>%
  mutate(processing_batch = "batch_2") %>%
  select(image_name, image_format, processing_batch)
batch_3 <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "batch_3.json")) %>%
  mutate(processing_batch = "batch_3") %>%
  select(image_name, image_format,  processing_batch)
batch_4 <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "batch_4.json"))  %>%
  mutate(processing_batch = "batch_4") %>%
  select(image_name, image_format, processing_batch)
batch_5 <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "batch_5.json"))  %>%
  mutate(processing_batch = "batch_5") %>%
  select(image_name, image_format, processing_batch)
batch_6 <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "batch_6.json")) %>%
  mutate(processing_batch = "batch_6") %>%
  select(image_name, image_format, processing_batch)

all_batches <- bind_rows(batch_0, batch_1, batch_2, batch_3, batch_4, batch_5, batch_6)

#Move not uploaded images to hard drive for upload
batch_1_not_uploaded <- all_batches %>% 
  filter(processing_batch == "batch_1" & !(image_name %in% image_metadata$image_name)) %>%
  mutate(file_name = paste(image_name, image_format, sep="."))

file_names <- batch_1_not_uploaded$file_name 

```
